_comment: FEMA NFIP documents indexed by Vertex AI Search for grounding. All are US Government works published by FEMA (public domain). 'url' is a direct PDF link when one is known; FEMA occasionally moves files, so 'landing_page' is where to find the current edition by hand. 'file' is the name used in grounding/raw/ and in gs://BUCKET/grounding/fema/.

documents.title: Standard Flood Insurance Policy - Dwelling Form (F-122)
documents.why: The policy wording itself: flood definition, what is covered, basement limits, exclusions, duties after a loss, proof of loss.

documents.title: NFIP Claims Handbook (for policyholders)
documents.why: Plain-language steps after a flood: documenting damage, what to keep, proof of loss, appeals.

documents.title: NFIP Claims Manual
documents.why: How adjusters handle NFIP claims; background for 'what happens next' questions.

documents.title: NFIP Flood Insurance Manual
documents.why: Underwriting and coverage rules; useful for coverage-limit and deductible questions.
